title: conversions/registry.ts is now the last hand-authored append registry — extend the #7297 per-entry split?
body:
Filed from PR #7454's open question (spec-lane PM seat #6017); recording only, not claiming.

## Context

PR #7454 (#7297) split `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`'s three append tables (59 semantic / 16 retired-keys / 45 retired-defs entries) into per-entry files under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/{semantic,retired-keys,retired-defs}/`, generated back into `registry.ts` between markers by `build-migration-registry.ts` (`gen:`/`check:migration-registry`, `--self-test`). Concatenation stays inside `registry.ts` because the browser-reachable barrel forbids `readdirSync`; `LEDGER_SOURCES` was deliberately unchanged.

`conversions/registry.ts` was **deliberately excluded** per the dispatch ruling "when in doubt, migrations only" — leaving it the last hand-authored append registry in the package.

## Question for triage

Does the same merge-conflict/append-contention argument that justified #7297 apply to `conversions/registry.ts`, and if so does `build-migration-registry.ts` generalize or does the conversions table need its own generator? A quick churn measurement (how often that file's append tables take concurrent edits) would settle the priority.

Natural lane if promoted: `domain:spec`. Reference implementation: PR #7454.
